purpose: Byte-for-byte capture of basedbox's effective Advantage360 layered, PCsensor footswitch and Hyprland Space Cadet mappings for a prepared NixOS configuration; not an activated system change.
sourceHeadMeaning: Revision of the containing /home/tay/src repository, not a claim that the working-tree files are clean or an independent manna-cadet upstream revision. Fresh file hashes and agreement with effective immutable Guix files are authoritative.

attribution.mannaCadet: Copyright (c) 2026 htayj; MIT License copied as LICENSE for the Advantage360 and XKB assets.
attribution.footswitches: Existing owner-provided dotfiles profile outside the manna-cadet directory. No separate license notice was found in the profile or at the dotfiles directory root; the manna-cadet MIT notice is not asserted to license this separate file.

files.observedState: Guile launcher waiting for PCsensor FootSwitch Keyboard; not an active Kanata footswitch process during capture.
files.outputDeviceName: kanata (upstream default, not overridden by the captured profile)
files.actualMapping: ralt/f24/menu/rmet -> f1/f2/f3/f4. Existing fs1-fs4 aliases are unused; preserve that actual behavior, not the profile comment's older sentinel example.

files.includeProvider: Stock xkeyboard-config includes provided by the NixOS Hyprland/libxkbcommon closure; no manna-cadet custom rules/symbol includes are referenced.

runtimeAdaptation.profileChanges: Only insert linux-continue-if-no-devs-found yes immediately after defcfg in generated immutable runtime copies. Vendored profiles remain unchanged.
runtimeAdaptation.reason: Native Kanata hotplug waiting supports absent physical devices on the installer/VM without intercepting unrelated keyboards or blocking desktop login. Syntax errors remain fatal in generated-config checkPhase and service startup.
runtimeAdaptation.permissions: NixOS services.kanata native hardened DynamicUser with input/uinput supplementary groups and device allow rules. No added tay input/uinput membership or broad chmod rules.
runtimeAdaptation.restart: on-failure, 30 seconds, up to 3 starts within 300 seconds. Normal emergency exit remains stopped. No desktop-login dependency.
runtimeAdaptation.nativeWarning: The native module may warn about footswitches.devices=[] with multiple profiles; its generic warning does not parse full configFile. The captured linux-dev-names-include filter excludes the Advantage360, so there is no wildcard grab.

preservedSemantics: Advantage360 process-unmapped-keys no, concurrent-tap-hold yes and all arbitrary-code actions, local Linux key numbers, base/fun layers and tap-hold-release timings (200ms except a at 250ms).
Thumb backspace/space holds emit ralt; End/PgDn holds enter fun. Footswitch process-unmapped-keys yes and exact all-device name matching are unchanged.

XKB physical RALT=Alt_L/Mod1; LALT=Meta_L/Mod3; RWIN=Hyper_L/Mod2; LWIN=Super_L/Mod4; LVL3=Mode_switch; ZEHA=ISO_Level3_Shift/Mod5. Compositor mainMod must remain ALT, not the historical Mod3 proposal.
Full Greek/top/math and private-use command keysyms unchanged. No new compositor command bindings are implied; applications consume these symbols as before.

verificationAndLimits.performed: Read canonical profiles, exact deployed immutable files and process command lines; SHA-256 canonical files matched effective home symlink contents and running/launcher config copies. No current remapper was restarted.
verificationAndLimits.notPerformedBySlice: No Nix evaluation/build, tests, lint, format, runtime keyboard grab, XKB compilation or physical typing smoke. Integration owner must perform the single integrated smoke.
verificationAndLimits.packageCompatibility: Observed current running Kanata is 1.12.0; pinned nixpkgs 26.05 supplies 1.11.0. Generated-config checkPhase checks actual selected package syntax. Parser success alone is not proof of identical tap-hold runtime behavior across versions; physical typing acceptance remains required.
verificationAndLimits.historicalHashes: The earlier mapping scout quoted frozen ivory-key baseline hashes, not fresh current hashes; those do not supersede this capture.
